jonny-desktop.task: meristem sprite readability pass: make quadruped/flyer builds silhouette-distinct, give tiles real structure + wrap-safe features, per-shape pickup colours, readable chests, distinct blade family
jonny-desktop.note: DONE + PUSHED, awaiting merge. Sprite readability pass shipped as PR #4 (branch feat/sprite-readability, commit d59d7cc). CI green on ubuntu + windows py3.12; full suite 153 passed. Six defects fixed, all found by rendering the library as pure alpha masks: (1) quadruped builds shared one hardcoded body loaf - now each declares back/belly knots that reshape the torso, worst silhouette pair 46px -> 144px; (2) flyer bird/moth were the same ellipse, now swept wing + tail fan vs fore/hind lobes + antennae, 60px -> 108px; (3) tile crack walk CLAMPED instead of wrapping, causing a dark smudge repeating at every seam - all features now go through wrap-safe _put/_disc; (4) _wave stepped 3 into a 16px tile so courses collided at the seam - periods are now named constants asserted to divide the tile; (5) grass/dirt/sand/snow/stone were one noise field recoloured - each got real structure; (6) pickups all defaulted to gold, chest had no lid seam, blades were one drawing at three scales. 9 new tests asserting on silhouette and colour, 5 of them verified to FAIL against main before merging. Deliberately did NOT ship an image-level tile-seam metric: measured it, it false-positives on brick and water whose own periods make a correct seam look broken, i.e. it reports CANNOT TELL as BROKEN. Decisions recorded as dec-011-b5c3 and dec-012-d904. RECOMMENDED NEXT: review and merge PR #4; the remaining known-weak sprites are ghost:specter (reads as a grey rounded rectangle) and the projectile pair fireball/bolt (near-identical orange spiky balls) - neither was in this scope.
